source.title: Breaking News Sends Stock from $3.00 to $12.45 in 2hrs!

research_notes: This is a deliberately included negative outcome: a micro entry was taken, initially moved slightly higher, then rejected and stopped out.
Primary scoring should test whether Micro v0.1 causally produces a comparable setup/entry and whether the later campaign engine exits on failure; profit magnitude is not a calibration target.
This retrospective label must never be supplied to a policy replaying March 27, 2026.
